integrity: The complete basis-pair proof and independent reproducible finite-field checker are supplied; finite enumeration alone is not the proof.
limitations: Only the reduced locus of even endomorphisms on the stated 4-dimensional graded algebra; no orbit classification, odd operators, or Yang-Baxter tensor classification. All-field equations proven algebraically, while the motivating article uses characteristic zero. Historical priority and external validation remain open.
title: Three irreducible components in the even Nijenhuis-operator locus of a four-dimensional perm superalgebra
